response.sql: WITH avg_entries AS (SELECT AVG(entry_count) as avg_count FROM (SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) as entry_count FROM constructorResults GROUP BY raceId) subq), race_counts AS (SELECT cr.raceId, COUNT(*) as entry_count, SUM(cr.points) as total_points FROM constructorResults cr GROUP BY cr.raceId) SELECT rc.raceId, c.country, rc.total_points, rc.entry_count, (rc.entry_count - ae.avg_count) as diff FROM race_counts rc CROSS JOIN avg_entries ae JOIN races r ON rc.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE rc.entry_count > ae.avg_count ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10;
